rules.recommendation: Optical Link Recommended: Zero electromagnetic radiation prevents medical telemetry interference. Direct line-of-sight ensures secure private transmission.
Optical Preferred over RF: RF emissions may interfere with sensitive EEG/MRI monitoring equipment in medical zones.
Hybrid Auto-Selective: Optical takes primary priority; RF transmitter power attenuated to prevent electromagnetic interference.
RF Link Recommended: Penetrates desks and partitions seamlessly; non-line-of-sight coverage keeps students connected anywhere in the room.
Optical Link Ideal for Front-Row Listening: High-brightness LED delivers crystal-clear audio with immunity to campus Wi-Fi and mobile noise.
Hybrid Dual-Link Optimal: Optical delivers pristine front-row clarity, while RF provides continuous coverage when line-of-sight is obstructed.
Optical Zone-Confinement Ideal: Exhibits each have a dedicated LED beacon; audio does not bleed into adjacent exhibit spaces.
RF Long-Range Active: Delivers overarching docent tour guide audio across wide gallery halls and architectural corridors.
Hybrid Multi-Zone Mode: Seamlessly switches between localized optical exhibit nodes and wide-area RF hall broadcasts.

default: Hybrid Dual-Link Mode: Dynamically combines long-range RF coverage (non-line-of-sight) with noise-immune Optical transmission for zero-drop listening.
